title: Fearless warrior
author: Aarti Mittal
text:
She, yes she the twelve year old
Sleeps with a corpse
In the sinister graveyard
Safe, secured and she feels
She says
There are human wolves outside this graveyard
Greedily waiting for me
To pounce on me
I lean on him
And he does not touch me
His fingers don`t probe for femininity
He lays allay proving his allegiance
The bright daylight outside
a black abyss
so called witty race
Is choking
In the captivity of lust
of the hunger for power and fame
Here my companion laying in allay
Guards me in his silence
I sleep with this corpse, safe and sound.
